title: SEO-optimized tool page: PDF to Word online free

requirements.summary: Create a dedicated, SEO-friendly, mobile-responsive landing page for the "PDF to Word online free" tool using existing site layout patterns and the primary theme color.
acceptanceCriteria: A new page component exists for the "PDF to Word online free" tool and renders correctly on desktop and mobile.

The page styling uses the existing Tailwind/Shadcn design system and clearly reflects the primary theme color (#eb347d) via the existing `primary` token usage (e.g., accents, buttons, icon highlights).
All user-facing text on the page is in English and is polished and SEO-friendly without keyword stuffing.

file_operations.description: Create the new tool landing page with a modern responsive layout (container widths, typography, spacing) matching existing pages (e.g., About/Contact). Use the shadcn-ui component library (e.g., Card/Button/Badge-like patterns) and Tailwind `text-primary`/`bg-primary` accents to reflect the theme. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add client-side routing so the new tool page is reachable under a clean /tools/ path via the app route list.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating directly to the new tool URL renders the tool page instead of the 404 page.
Internal navigation using the app router works (no full page reload required).

file_operations.description: Register a new route entry for the tool page under a descriptive path such as `/tools/pdf-to-word-online-free`, rendering the new PdfToWordOnlineFreePage component.

requirements.summary: Implement on-page SEO for the tool route by updating document title and meta description while the tool page is active, with cleanup on navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: When visiting the tool page, `document.title` is updated to include "PDF to Word online free".
When visiting the tool page, the `<meta name="description">` content is updated to an SEO-optimized description that includes "PDF to Word online free".
Navigating away from the tool page restores the appropriate title/description for other routes (at minimum, the homepage values from `frontend/index.html`).

file_operations.description: Add a lightweight hook that sets `document.title` and updates/creates the `<meta name="description">` tag when mounted, storing initial values (from runtime DOM, matching `frontend/index.html`) and restoring them on unmount.
Use the new usePageSeo hook to set an SEO-optimized title and meta description that explicitly include "PDF to Word online free" while this page is rendered.

requirements.summary: Add a UI-driven PDF-to-Word conversion interface (PDF-only selection, convert action, loading/progress, and demo download result) with accessible controls.
acceptanceCriteria: The interface accepts only .pdf files (client-side validation) and shows a helpful error message for invalid types.
The Convert button is disabled until a valid PDF is selected.
A conversion state is shown (e.g., progress indicator/spinner) after clicking Convert.
After completion, a result area is shown with a Download button (may download a placeholder/demo file if real conversion is not implemented).
The UI uses accessible labels, focus states, and clear contrast for interactive elements.

file_operations.description: Implement the Tool Interface section: drag-and-drop + file picker restricted to PDF, selected file details, Convert CTA, simulated progress/loading state, and a clearly labeled demo result area with a Download action (e.g., generating a placeholder .docx-like blob). Use shadcn-ui styled building blocks (e.g., Card/Button/Input/Label patterns) and Tailwind focus rings for accessibility. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a step-by-step usage section with clear numbered instructions aligned to the on-page interface.
acceptanceCriteria: The section contains a clear heading and at least 4 concise numbered steps.
Steps match the actual UI controls and terminology on the page (e.g., Upload/Select PDF, Convert, Download).

file_operations.description: Add a "Step-by-step usage" section with at least 4 numbered steps that match the page’s UI terminology (Select/Drop PDF → Convert → Wait for completion → Download demo result).

requirements.summary: Add a benefits section using a responsive card/grid layout with icons and subtle hover transitions consistent with the site.
acceptanceCriteria: The section contains a clear heading and a set of benefit items (at least 4).
Benefit items are presented in a responsive grid and include an icon and short description.
Hover/focus styling is present and consistent with existing components (subtle elevation/border/primary accent).

file_operations.description: Add a "Benefits" section with at least 4 items in a responsive grid, each including an icon (e.g., lucide-react) and short copy. Use shadcn-ui Card-like styling and lightweight hover transitions (shadow/border/primary accents). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an accessible FAQ accordion with at least 6 relevant Q&A items without overstating simulated conversion capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: The FAQ section contains at least 6 Q&A items relevant to PDF-to-Word conversion.
FAQ items are expandable/collapsible and keyboard accessible (focusable triggers, Enter/Space toggles).
FAQ copy is clear, accurate, and does not promise capabilities the tool does not implement (if conversion is simulated, the FAQ must not imply real conversion is performed).

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight, accessible accordion component (keyboard operable triggers with appropriate ARIA attributes, focus states, and Tailwind styling aligned to shadcn-ui tokens). Use subtle transitions only. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an FAQ section using the new AccessibleAccordion with at least 6 Q&A items specific to "PDF to Word online free" (privacy, limits, compatibility, quality, troubleshooting). Ensure answers explicitly describe the interface as a demo/simulated conversion where applicable.
